speaker: god
text: Go, take a prostitute as your wife and have children of adultery, because this land is flagrantly prostituting itself by departing from the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Name him Jezreel, for soon I will bring the bloodshed of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And on that day I will break the bow of Israel in the Valley of Jezreel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Name her Lo-ruhamah, for I will no longer have compassion on the house of Israel, that I should ever forgive them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet I will have compassion on the house of Judah, and I will save them—not by bow or sword or war, not by horses and cavalry, but by the LORD their God.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Name him Lo-ammi, for you are not My people, and I am not your God.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet the number of the Israelites will be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or counted. And it will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then the people of Judah and of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint for themselves one leader, and will go up out of the land. For great will be the day of Jezreel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Say of your brothers, ‘My people,’ and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not My wife, and I am not her husband. Let her remove the adultery from her face and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Otherwise, I will strip her naked and expose her like the day of her birth. I will make her like a desert and turn her into a parched land, and I will let her die of thirst.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will have no compassion on her children, because they are the children of adultery.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For their mother has played the harlot and has conceived them in disgrace. For she thought, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me bread and water, wool and linen, oil and drink.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up her path with thorns; I will enclose her with a wall, so she cannot find her way.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: She will pursue her lovers but not catch them; she will seek them but not find them. Then she will say, ‘I will return to my first husband, for then I was better off than now.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For she does not acknowledge that it was I who gave her grain, new wine, and oil, who lavished on her silver and gold— which they crafted for Baal.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore I will take back My grain in its time and My new wine in its season; I will take away My wool and linen, which were given to cover her nakedness.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And then I will expose her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of My hands.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will put an end to all her exultation: her feasts, New Moons, and Sabbaths— all her appointed feasts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will destroy her vines and fig trees, which she thinks are the wages paid by her lovers. So I will make them into a thicket, and the beasts of the field will devour them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will punish her for the days of the Baals when she burned incense to them, when she decked herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers. But Me she forgot,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore, behold, I will allure her and lead her to the wilderness, and speak to her tenderly.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: There I will give back her vineyards and make the Valley of Achor into a gateway of hope. There she will respond as she did in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of Egypt.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In that day,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: you will call Me ‘my Husband,’ and no longer call Me ‘my Master.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I will remove from her lips the names of the Baals; no longer will their names be invoked.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air and the creatures that crawl on the ground. And I will abolish bow and sword and weapons of war in the land, and will make them lie down in safety.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will betroth you to Me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in loving devotion and compassion.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will know the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day I will respond—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And the earth will respond to the grain, to the new wine and oil, and they will respond to Jezreel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will sow her as My own in the land, and I will have compassion on ‘No Compassion.’ I will say to those called ‘Not My People,’ ‘You are My people,’ and they will say, ‘You are my God.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go show love to your wife again, though she is loved by another and is an adulteress. Love her as the LORD loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and offer raisin cakes to idols.
name: The LORD

speaker: hosea
text: You must live with me for many days; you must not be promiscuous or belong to another, and I will do the same for you.
name: Hosea

speaker: god
text: There is no truth, no loving devotion, and no knowledge of God in the land!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Cursing and lying, murder and stealing, and adultery are rampant; one act of bloodshed follows another.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore the land mourns, and all who dwell in it will waste away with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air; even the fish of the sea disappear.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But let no man contend; let no man offer reproof; for your people are like those who contend with a priest.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You will stumble by day, and the prophet will stumble with you by night; so I will destroy your mother—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you as My priests. Since you have forgotten the law of your God, I will also forget your children.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The more they multiplied, the more they sinned against Me; they exchanged their Glory for a thing of disgrace.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They feed on the sins of My people and set their hearts on iniquity.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And it shall be like people, like priest. I will punish both of them for their ways and repay them for their deeds.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will eat but not be satisfied; they will be promiscuous but not multiply. For they have stopped obeying the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Promiscuity, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: My people consult their wooden idols, and their divining rods inform them. For a spirit of prostitution leads them astray and they have played the harlot against their God.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn offerings on the hills, under oak, poplar, and terebinth, because their shade is pleasant. And so your daughters turn to prostitution and your daughters-in-law to adultery.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will not punish your daughters when they prostitute themselves, nor your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery. For the men themselves go off with prostitutes and offer sacrifices with shrine prostitutes. So a people without understanding will come to ruin.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Though you prostitute yourself, O Israel, may Judah avoid such guilt! Do not journey to Gilgal, do not go up to Beth-aven, and do not swear on oath, ‘As surely as the LORD lives!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For Israel is as obstinate as a stubborn heifer. Can the LORD now shepherd them like lambs in an open meadow?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Ephraim is joined to idols; leave him alone!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: When their liquor is gone, they turn to prostitution; their rulers dearly love disgrace.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The whirlwind has wrapped them in its wings, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Hear this, O priests! Take heed, O house of Israel! Give ear, O royal house! For this judgment is against you because you have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The rebels are deep in slaughter; but I will chastise them all.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I know all about Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from Me. For now, O Ephraim, you have turned to prostitution; Israel is defiled.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God, for a spirit of prostitution is within them, and they do not know the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them; Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity; even Judah stumbles with them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They go with their flocks and herds to seek the LORD, but they do not find Him; He has withdrawn Himself from them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They have been unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the New Moon will devour them along with their land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Blow the ram’s horn in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah; raise the battle cry in Beth-aven: Lead on, O Benjamin!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The princes of Judah are like those who move boundary stones; I will pour out My fury upon them like water.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, for he is determined to follow worthless idols.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like decay to the house of Judah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: When Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his wound, then Ephraim turned to Assyria and sent to the great king. But he cannot cure you or heal your wound.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I am like a lion to Ephraim and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, even I, will tear them to pieces and then go away. I will carry them off where no one can rescue them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then I will return to My place until they admit their guilt and seek My face; in their affliction they will earnestly seek Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: O our God, we know You!
name: Israel

speaker: israelites
text: We have no king, for we do not revere the LORD. What can a king do for us?
name: Israel

speaker: israelites
text: Cover us!
name: Israel

speaker: israelites
text: Fall on us!
name: Israel

speaker: israelites
text: How rich I have become! I have found wealth for myself. In all my labors, they can find in me no iniquity that is sinful.
name: Israel

speaker: israelites
text: Give me a king and princes
name: Israel

speaker: israelites
text: Take away all our iniquity and receive us graciously, that we may present the fruit of our lips.
name: Israel

speaker: israelites
text: Assyria will not save us, nor will we ride on horses. We will never again say, ‘Our gods!’ to the work of our own hands. For in You the fatherless find compassion.
name: Israel
